purpose: Schema for static structural inventory records shaped to remain mechanically comparable with legacy_intent_atlas.json and native_intent_satisfaction_ledger.json; not a completed primary active-code Atlas schema proof.
validation_rules: This is static structural evidence only. It does not prove semantic correctness, native satisfaction, implementation maturity, or test pass status.
Every record must have a unique active_code_record_id.
Every record must cite an existing source_file unless status is blocked and blockers explain the missing source.
source_line_start and source_line_end must be positive integers within the cited file line count and source_line_start <= source_line_end.
blueprint_surface must be one of the eighteen governed architecture surfaces or blocked_blueprint.
Runtime code, tests, config/data, receipts, and docstrings must remain distinguishable via record_type/evidence_status.
No record may claim implementation proof solely from static source existence.
Original Atlas/Bridge JSON files may be listed as evidence surfaces but must not be rewritten by this workstream.
limitation_statement: This is static structural evidence only. It does not prove semantic correctness, native satisfaction, implementation maturity, or test pass status.
